def kernel(A: Float[Array, '15 15']):
    bprobe_trace = []
    A[0, 0] = np.sqrt(A[0, 0])
    for i in range(1, A.shape[0]):
        for j in range(i):
            bprobe_v0 = A[i, :j]
            bprobe_trace.append((0, bprobe_v0))
            bprobe_v1 = A[j, :j]
            bprobe_trace.append((1, bprobe_v1))
            A[i, j] -= np.dot(bprobe_v0, bprobe_v1)
            A[i, j] /= A[j, j]
        bprobe_v2 = A[i, :i]
        bprobe_trace.append((2, bprobe_v2))
        bprobe_v3 = A[i, :i]
        bprobe_trace.append((3, bprobe_v3))
        A[i, i] -= np.dot(bprobe_v2, bprobe_v3)
        A[i, i] = np.sqrt(A[i, i])
    return bprobe_trace
